description: (Na)₂NaAlCl₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a NaAlCl₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaAlCl₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AlCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.68 Å. Al is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form AlCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Al-Cl bond lengths are 2.33 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Al atom.
